nodes.title: Gate: maintainer signs off the orchestration panels' information design and the read-only scope for 0.3.1

acceptance: gui/pm-gantt/src/orchestrationSnapshot.ts declares the snapshot type: its required fields are exactly M16.3.1's v1 list (schema; per leaf key the claim {codename, branch, registered_at}, workers {id, harness, model, status, pid_alive, started_at, ended_at}, worktrees {path, branch, dirty} and reviews {model, verdict, commit, fresh_for_head}; leafless workers) with status in claimed, running, exited_ok, exited_failed, abandoned, unknown; the schema 2 additions are optional: worker account (string or null), last_activity, flags (string list); worktree ahead, behind (integer or "unknown"); per leaf ready {commit, model, at, blocked_on? [{acceptance, reason}]}, gate {state (a `handoff status` label), approvals (integer), blocks (integer), fresh_for_head}, holds (a list of {source ("hold_list" or "gate"), id, reason (string or null)}, M17.1 question 4); the module exports `requiredKeys` and `optionalKeys` (key paths) and this sheet lists them for M17.6

gui/pm-gantt/src/fixtures/orchestration_snapshot_mock.json covers every status value, a leaf with two worktrees, a leafless worker, an `unknown` field, a null account, a stale review (fresh_for_head false), gate states blocked and executor_blocked (a READY with blocked_on), a leaf held by the hold list (with a reason) and one held by an open gate, a worker whose flags are stalled and steering_changed and one flagged paused_by_limit; a vitest test fails when a mock key path is in neither `requiredKeys` nor `optionalKeys` or a `requiredKeys` path is missing

`buildOrchestrationView(snapshot, outline, now)` in the same module (no React, no fetch) joins each leaf key to the outline's `node_key` for display id, title and order (outline order, then keys absent from the outline by key, then leafless workers); picks one leaf badge with M17.1's precedence, where blocked means gate.state blocked or executor_blocked with count gate.blocks or the number of ready.blocked_on entries; formats ages with `formatRelativeAge` (lastWorked.ts) from `now`; renders `unknown` as "unknown" and an absent or null optional field as "—" (except account: null or absent shows an empty cell, M17.1 question 3), never as false, 0 or clean

Table-driven vitest rows with a fixed clock: each badge candidate alone, each adjacent precedence pair on one leaf, reversed worker order, numeric-looking display ids in outline order, a schema 1 snapshot (no optional fields), explicit unknown, null account, an empty snapshot and leafless workers only, each with its expected groups, badge and text; no component, route or existing type changes; `cd gui/pm-gantt && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` passes
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): frontend about +400 (module, tests and mock)
nodes.title: PM GUI: orchestration snapshot types, a mock snapshot and a pure view model, tested against the mock

acceptance: A header button "Orchestration" opens a read-only drawer: one group per leaf from M17.2's view model (display id, title, leaf badge, claim codename, branch and registered age), then a "No leaf" group; each worker row shows id, harness / model, account, status, last activity age, started / ended and one badge per `flags` entry, verbatim (exited_failed shows in the status column; a null account is an empty cell); an optional `filterLeafId` prop (null shows every group) shows only that leaf's group

api.ts gains `fetchOrchestration()` built on `loadOrchestration(fetchImpl)` in orchestrationSnapshot.ts; vitest rows with an injected fetch assert one GET to /api/orchestration per load, 404 -> unavailable (the drawer says the server does not provide the orchestration snapshot yet) and any other failure -> error; a vitest over OrchestrationDrawer.tsx's source fails on any import from api.ts other than `fetchOrchestration`; the mock renders only in a dev build (`import.meta.env.DEV`) with `?mock=orchestration`; no existing request in api.ts changes

Clicking a leaf id opens the existing edit modal for that node; clicking a worker opens the existing Workers drawer on that worker through a new optional WorkersDrawer prop `initialWorkerId`, selected through createWorkerSelection on open (without it the current newest-worker default stays; workerSelection tests gain both rows); the drawer reloads on open, on Refresh and every 15 s while it is open (one interval, cleared on close and unmount, no request while closed; M17.1 question 5, 2026-11-06), with vitest rows on fake timers: open -> one load, +15 s -> one more, closed -> none

Copy-CLI buttons (M17.1 question 2, 2026-11-06): each worker row copies `specy-road worker status <id>` and `specy-road worker open <id>`, each leaf header copies `specy-road handoff status <NODE_ID>`, built by a pure copyCommand(kind, id) in orchestrationSnapshot.ts that single-quotes any id outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] (vitest rows include an id with a quote, a space and `$(...)`); a click only calls navigator.clipboard.writeText (no request; a failure shows 'copy failed'). App.tsx grows only by the button, the open state and the lazy mount (under 30 lines); `cd gui/pm-gantt && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` passes
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): frontend about +330
nodes.title: PM GUI: a read-only Orchestration drawer lists workers per leaf with state, harness and model, account, last activity and flags

acceptance: LeafOrchestrationDetail shows for one leaf: the claim; each worktree (path, branch, dirty yes / no / unknown, ahead and behind the integration branch or "—"); the newest READY (short commit, model, age) and its blocked_on entries as plain-text `A<n>: <reason>` lines; each review record (model, verdict, commit, fresh for HEAD); the gate summary (state, approvals, blocks, fresh for HEAD); and holds (each hold's source, id and reason: the hold list's reason, or the open gate's id and title)

Review freshness follows the snapshot's fresh_for_head only ("unknown" stays unknown; READY.commit is shown separately and never compared); blocking verdicts list first; fields a schema 1 server omits, or null, show "—"; view-model rows cover a fresh carried approval whose commit differs from READY.commit (not stale), a stale review, an unknown one and a schema 1 leaf

The detail shows in the Orchestration drawer for a selected leaf and (M17.1 question 6, 2026-11-06) as a collapsed read-only "Orchestration" section in the existing edit modal for leaf nodes; the edit modal's save paths and their tests are unchanged; the detail has a copy button for `specy-road handoff status <NODE_ID>` through M17.3's copyCommand (clipboard only)
`cd gui/pm-gantt && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` passes
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): frontend about +250
nodes.title: PM GUI: per-leaf orchestration detail shows worktrees with dirty and ahead/behind, the READY commit, review verdicts with fresh-for-head, and the gate state

acceptance: When the snapshot is available each leaf row's existing Task cell shows at most one badge chosen by the view model (blocked / held, exited_failed, stalled, running, READY awaiting review, approved, claimed, abandoned, unknown), with a hover listing claim, workers, worktree count, READY and review summary; no column is added (`TABLE_COLS` stays 6) and a row with no orchestration state shows nothing new

A held leaf's hover names each hold from the snapshot's holds ('hold list: <reason>', or 'hold list' without one, and each open gate id; "—" when the server sends none); a blocked leaf shows "blocked" with the count (gate.blocks, or the number of ready.blocked_on entries for executor_blocked); view-model rows for snapshot present, snapshot unavailable (404) and no state assert badge text, hover text and the leaf key a click passes

Clicking the badge opens the Orchestration drawer with M17.3's `filterLeafId` set to that leaf key (passed from App.tsx); the snapshot loads once per roadmap refresh and, while the Orchestration drawer is open, takes each of the drawer's loads (no interval of its own; M17.1 question 5, 2026-11-06); when `GET /api/orchestration` answers 404 the outline renders exactly as before (existing outline, tableCols and gantt tests unchanged)
App.tsx grows by under 20 lines; `cd gui/pm-gantt && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` passes
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): frontend about +170
nodes.title: PM GUI: the outline shows one orchestration badge per leaf for claims, holds, running or failed workers and review state, linking into the drawer

acceptance: `orchestration.state.snapshot(repo_root)` returns `schema: 2`: every v1 field keeps its name, type and value; it adds per worker `account` (M17.1 question 3, 2026-11-06: the Claude profile name when the worker record or its roster entry names the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR it ran with, i.e. that directory's name, or its parent's when the directory is named claude or .claude (`work` for ~/.agent-accounts/work/claude); else null; never a path, credential or environment value), `last_activity` (the newer of the last event time and last_output_at) and `flags` (the record's flags verbatim, plus `paused_by_limit` while the record's state is paused_by_limit: a usage-limit pause is a worker flag, never a hold); per worktree `ahead` and `behind` (integers against the local integration ref, else "unknown"); per leaf `ready` {commit, model, at (the file's mtime, ISO UTC), blocked_on (the READY's entries while it is current at the commit under review, else absent)} from the READY latest_ready selects for the registered branch, `gate` {state (the label `handoff status` reports), approvals and blocks (integers: counted approvals and counted blocking records), fresh_for_head} and `holds` (M17.1 question 4, 2026-11-06: {source: "hold_list", id: the leaf id, reason: the text after `#` or null} when the leaf is listed in the main checkout's gitignored work/grind-hold.txt (M18.20's format: one id per line, `#` starts a reason; read only as a regular file, an unreadable one sets holds to unknown), plus {source: "gate", id, reason: the gate's title} per open gate the leaf depends on, as list-gates reports); tests/fixtures/orchestration_snapshot_v2.json is a full schema 2 snapshot whose key paths are exactly orchestrationSnapshot.ts's `requiredKeys` plus `optionalKeys` (a name change edits the TypeScript and the mock here, and `cd gui/pm-gantt && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` then passes)

Read-only and total: the builder writes nothing, runs no stall sweep, ack, fetch, check or harness command, and every git call passes `-c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null` with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; a non-UTF-8, non-mapping or schema-invalid READY, review or worker record sets only that source's fields to `unknown` and keeps readable siblings; tests through snapshot(): one byte fixture per malformed class, a missing integration ref, and a worktree whose core.fsmonitor names a sentinel-writing script (the sentinel stays absent and `git status --porcelain` of the main checkout is unchanged)

The gate summary calls the review gate's existing public function (no re-implementation); a table through snapshot() covers passed gate, counted block, stale-only review, insufficient approvals, executor blocker, policy error, absent READY and unreadable READY, asserting each leaf's full ready and gate values; a seeded secret environment value and config-dir path appear in no snapshot string; the layering gate, M16.3.1's parity rows and `worker list`, `orchestrate plan` and doctor output stay unchanged; docs/orchestration.md documents schema 2
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +180, tests about +280
nodes.title: Orchestration snapshot schema 2: optional fields for the PM GUI (worker account, last activity and flags; worktree ahead/behind; READY, gate summary and holds per leaf)

acceptance: `GET /api/orchestration` returns `orchestration.state.snapshot(<main project root>)` unchanged, with no added keys (display ids come from the GUI's outline, M17.2); the handler imports only `specy_road.orchestration` (the layering gate stays green), lives in the gui_app module M16.3.7 folded, and leaves the app's loopback-only CORS setting unchanged

It works under `specy-road gui --read-only`, where `POST /api/orchestration` answers 403; every existing `/api/` route keeps its response shape (existing GUI tests unchanged, including tests/test_gui_outline_contract.py and tests/test_gui_app_workers.py); this is the only route added

A contract test fails when a response key path is not in tests/fixtures/orchestration_snapshot_v2.json, or when gui/pm-gantt/src/fixtures/orchestration_snapshot_mock.json has a key path the fixture lacks or lacks a required one

Table-driven tests over fixture repos: no orchestration state (200, empty); a claim with a running worker and a READY; a non-UTF-8 worker record and READY (200, only those fields `unknown`); served from a linked worktree with divergent local state (reads the main worktree's claims, READY and workers); a nested project root (serves that project, not the enclosing repository's roadmap); a seeded secret environment value and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR path appear nowhere in the body
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +40, tests about +200

nodes.title: PM GUI orchestration view: docs/pm-gui.md and pm-workflow.md sections, the API table row, the CHANGELOG entry and a live check against the real route

acceptance: Run by the coordinator, not CI and not a worker, only once gate M17.10 records the maintainer's dated approval to use the sandbox; RESULTS.md cites that approval and keeps to its limits

tests/sandbox/pm_gui_orchestration/ holds a setup script that builds the wheel (after `npm run build`), creates a fixture repo from tests/fixtures/specy_road_dogfood seeded with orchestration state (a claim with a running worker whose pid is an inert child process the script supervises and kills on exit, success or failure; a failed worker flagged stalled; a leaf with two worktrees one dirty; a READY with one approving and one stale review; a held leaf; a leafless worker) and starts `specy-road gui --read-only`, waiting for an HTTP 200 rather than a fixed sleep; a browser test script for sbvm_run_browser_test; and CHECKLIST.md with the expected badge and detail values per item

The run uses the sandbox MCP tools (claim_workspace, vm_start, sbvm_exec to install the wheel and run setup, sbvm_run_browser_test, sbvm_screenshot) and covers each checklist item: drawer groups and flags, leaf detail (stale review, ahead/behind, holds), outline badge and its link, the 404 message (the browser script answers `GET /api/orchestration` with 404 by request interception, or a stub server in this directory does), and `POST /api/orchestration` answering 403 under --read-only

RESULTS.md records date, wheel version and commit, VM image, pass / fail per checklist item and screenshot names (screenshots stay under work/, gitignored), and lists each defect for the coordinator to file as a new M17 leaf in a separate roadmap operation; this leaf edits nothing outside its zone, and the M16.8.9 gate stays held until every filed leaf is Complete
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): tests/sandbox about +280; package 0

acceptance: The node edit dialog shows an Acceptance section with the node's criteria, one text field per criterion, with add, remove, move up and move down; saving sends PATCH /api/nodes/{id} with the one pair {key: 'acceptance', value: the criteria joined by a newline} through the edit modal's save queue (fingerprint and milestone lock as for the other fields), which is edit-node --set acceptance= semantics (one criterion per line, surrounding whitespace trimmed, empty criteria dropped, an empty list sends '' and removes the field); a newline typed inside a criterion is refused in the dialog with a message, never split; the GUI node type gains `acceptance?: string[]` read from GET /api/roadmap; no server, route or body change

Vitest rows over a pure helper (acceptanceEdit.ts): an unchanged list -> no PATCH; an added, removed, reordered and emptied list -> the exact pair value; a whitespace-only criterion dropped; a criterion containing a newline -> refused with the message; save-queue rows for the acceptance field next to an unrelated field edit

A contract test in tests/test_gui_app_mutations.py PATCHes the exact body the helper builds on a fixture repo and reads the node's acceptance back through GET /api/roadmap (and '' removes it); existing GUI tests unchanged. `cd gui/pm-gantt && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` passes; specy_road/pm_gantt_static/ rebuilt; docs/pm-gui.md's edit dialog entry and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Added
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): frontend about +220, tests about +60, docs about +5
docs/pm-gui.md's edit dialog entry also says that GUI edits change the graph only, and that roadmap.md and roadmap-context.md are regenerated by Publish (or specy-road export and digest)
nodes.title: PM GUI: view and edit a node's acceptance criteria in the node edit dialog, through the existing PATCH and edit-node semantics

acceptance: A 'Group siblings…' action on a selected outline row opens a dialog: the row's siblings as checkboxes (the selected row checked), a new parent id prefilled with the parent's next unused child id from the loaded outline (editable), a required title, a type (milestone by default) and 'rewrite id references in prose' (off by default); confirm sends one POST /api/outline/group with GroupOutlineBody's existing fields {into_new, title, node_ids (in outline order), type, rewrite_refs} through a new api.ts groupOutline(), with the PM write header and the pending-mutation and retry handling the move action uses; no server, route or body change

A refusal shows the server's 400 detail verbatim in the dialog and changes nothing in the outline; on success the outline refreshes and selects the new parent. Vitest rows over a pure helper (outlineGroup.ts): siblings of a row, the default id (including a parent whose children have gaps), the body from the dialog state, refusal of an empty title or no row checked

A contract test in tests/test_gui_outline_contract.py posts the exact body the helper builds on a fixture repo -> the new parent holds the nodes in order; a taken id -> 400 with its detail; existing outline tests unchanged. `cd gui/pm-gantt && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` passes; specy_road/pm_gantt_static/ rebuilt; docs/pm-gui.md and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Added
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): frontend about +250, tests about +60, docs about +5
nodes.title: PM GUI: a group-siblings outline action that calls the existing POST /api/outline/group

acceptance: A single click on an outline row selects it on the click itself (OutlineTable.tsx's handleRowClick no longer waits for the 220 ms timer before onSelectRow); a double click still opens the edit modal on that row; title-click editing, long press and dependency-edit clicks behave as today

Toolbar actions (add above and below, indent, outdent, move, delete) read the selection at click time, so an action clicked right after a row click targets that row (rc4 final sandbox 2026-11-06 F1: 2 of 2 immediate Add task below clicks went to the previous row)

Vitest rows with fake timers over a pure helper (outlineRowClick.ts) that holds the click / double-click decision: click -> select at once; click then a second click inside the double-click window -> one select, then open the modal; a click while a title is being edited -> no select; row click then an immediate toolbar action -> the clicked row's id. `cd gui/pm-gantt && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` passes; specy_road/pm_gantt_static/ rebuilt; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): frontend about +60
A row whose drag alone is disabled is not marked aria-disabled (OutlineTable.tsx useSortable), with one vitest pure-helper case
